title: Currying with a specified K-flat coefficient sheaf
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site, R a sheaf of commutative rings, U an object, S an R_U-module sheaf whose single complex S[0] is K-flat, and P a complex of R-module sheaves with K-flat restriction to C/U [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-localization-complex-models]. For every unbounded derived N construct an evaluation-normalized isomorphism RHom(S[0],RHom(P|U,N|U))≅RHom(S tensor P|U,N|U), where the last tensor is the ordinary termwise tensor complex. It is the component of a single natural isomorphism on the full subcategory of complexes with K-flat restriction, paired with the derived target category. Thus it is natural in every chain map of those complexes and every derived target morphism. The construction is canonical K-flat currying [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-rhom-currying], transported by exact restriction and the single-total-tensor comparison.

proof.text: Apply canonical K-flat currying to S[0], P|U and N|U. Transport the first restricted derived object through the exact restriction factorization, and the total tensor through the single-left-factor tensor isomorphism. These fixed maps define the claimed isomorphism without selecting an arbitrary witness.

Construct the comparison once as a natural isomorphism on complexes with K-flat restriction, paired with derived targets. Define each model comparison by component projection. Its naturality is then the naturality of this shared structure, with only the explicit functor-map equations unfolded. This avoids repeatedly unfolding the entire derived comparison term.

def modelCurryIso (U : C) (S : localizationModules (R.over U))
    (hS : KFlatRHom.flat (R.over U)
      ((HomologicalComplex.single (localizationModules (R.over U)) (.up ℤ) 0).obj S))
    (P : CochainComplex (localizationModules R) ℤ)
    (hP : KFlatRHom.flat (R.over U) ((localizationComplexRestriction R U).obj P))
    (N : localizationDerived R) :
    (localizationRHom (R.over U)).obj
      (op (derivedCoefficient R U S), (localizationRHom (R.over U)).obj
        (op ((localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj ((localizationQ R).obj P)),
          (localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj N)) ≅
    (localizationRHom (R.over U)).obj
      (op ((localizationQ (R.over U)).obj ((coefficientComplex R U S).obj P)),
        (localizationDerivedRestriction R U).obj N)
